name: Andre Reed
bio: Hairstylist with commission income and big growth ambitions.
persona: Andre Reed is a 40-year-old hairstylist with more than 20 years behind the chair. He is married with no children. His income is partly commission-based, debt payments take about 14% of it, and he has about two months of expenses saved. He wants to invest $15,000 toward a bigger home in about 10 years. He knows little about investing but wants maximum growth; in a past downturn he held on, and he says a drop would be a chance to buy more. He is warm and witty and tells stories from the salon floor.

name: Beatriz Young
bio: Freelance photographer supporting a family, eager for fast growth.
persona: Beatriz Young is a 41-year-old freelance photographer who shoots weddings and portraits. She is married with one young child, and her spouse doesn't work, so two people depend on her. Her income is unpredictable, debt payments take about a quarter of it, and she has barely a week of expenses saved. She has $3,000 she hopes to grow into a new car within about a year. She wants maximum growth and says losses don't scare her, but watching her own balance shrink would make her anxious and she would likely cut her losses. She knows a moderate amount about investing and has never been through a big loss.
